images.why: June 2026 photograph attached to the specifically named Tjotafossen waypoint. Low-resolution fallback: linked rendition is only 700 × 525.

images.author: John Bernhard Rekstad
images.why: Archival photograph from 1900 explicitly catalogued as Tjøtabreen and Tjøtafossen. Monochrome fallback, not a strong colour-poster choice; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Johnny Cheng
images.why: Strong early-July 2005 flow at the correctly identified Romsdalen waterfall, viewed from the E136 corridor. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Second documented July 2005 photograph of Døntefossen, with white water against the cliff and green foreground. Individual photographer and dimensions unverified.

images.author: Knud Knudsen
images.why: Authentic 1888 photograph explicitly catalogued as Døntefos in Romsdalen. Monochrome archival fallback; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Knud Knudsen
images.why: Distinct 1870 photograph explicitly locating Døntefossen between Flatmark and Ormheim. Historical landscape fallback; dimensions unverified.

images.why: Correctly catalogued 1902 photograph. Lowest-priority fallback: monochrome and tagged with ice, so less suitable for the requested flowing-water presentation.

images.author: Barbara Sheldrake
images.why: Strong first choice: 5792 × 8688 portrait photograph, captured June 2017 and tagged Upper Fall, Middle Cascades and Lower Fall; ample cropping resolution.

images.author: Laszlo Magyar
images.why: Springtime Yosemite Falls photograph tagged as a vertical shot; promising portrait-card composition. Original download linked; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Vern Clevenger
images.why: Classic full-falls composition from June 2011, documented by the photographer as an exceptionally high-runoff year. Linked rendition uses a 2000-pixel bounding box.

images.author: Noah Lang
images.why: Classic Cook’s Meadow setting with green meadow, granite wall and blue sky. Landscape composition requires a portrait crop; linked rendition requests 2500 pixels wide.

images.author: Noah Lang
images.why: Separate photograph explicitly captioned Yosemite Falls from Cook’s Meadow, offering an alternative classic valley viewpoint. Full-size linked file; dimensions unverified.

images.author: César Badilla Miranda
images.why: Colourful wide-angle Yosemite Falls photograph with clear blue sky and valley context, recorded with a Canon EOS 6D Mark II. Linked rendition requests 3000 pixels wide.

images.author: Martin Lawrence
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies both Upper and Lower Yosemite Falls in this composition, with strong water and natural tree framing. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Brian Hawkins
images.why: Distinctive portrait night photograph with a moonbow and reflection, providing strong colour and atmosphere. Resolution compromise: linked rendition is 1024 × 1536.
